## Requirement

Describe the defect, requirement, or research objective.

## Implementation

Summarize the source and documentation changes.

## Validation

List exact commands, environments, artifacts, and results. State every tier not
run.

## Claim Boundary

State what the evidence proves and what remains unqualified or human-gated.

## Rollback

Describe how to revert the change without rewriting published history.

- [ ] Focused tests pass.
- [ ] Full default tests pass.
- [ ] Long/optional tiers were run when relevant, or their omission is stated.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] No release, licence, or publication authority is implied.
